spoken_en.text: the greatest common divisor of a and b
the greatest common factor of a and b
the GCF of a and b
the gcd of a and b

spoken_ja: a と b の最大公約数
notes: gcd(a, b) は the greatest common divisor of a and b か the gcd of a and b（G C D）と読む。GCF(a, b) は the greatest common factor of a and b か the GCF of a and b と読む。
IM Grade 6（7.16 Common Factors）と OpenStax Prealgebra 2e（10.6）は greatest common factor（GCF）と呼ぶ。
